initial_question: Which assets, including all equipment types and statuses, have no recorded failure events in the last 12 months as of 1 October 2026?
initial_sql: SELECT TOP 1001 [e].[equipment_id] AS [equipment_id], [e].[site_id] AS [site_id], [e].[asset_code] AS [asset_code], [e].[equipment_type] AS [equipment_type], [e].[commissioned_at] AS [commissioned_at], [e].[status] AS [status] FROM [demo].[equipment] AS [e] WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 AS [1] FROM [demo].[failure_events] AS [f] WHERE [f].[equipment_id] = [e].[equipment_id] AND [f].[occurred_at] >= DATEADD(MONTH, -12, CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATETIME2(0))) AND [f].[occurred_at] < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATETIME2(0)))
proposed_sql:
SELECT e.equipment_id, e.site_id, e.asset_code, e.equipment_type, e.commissioned_at, e.status
FROM demo.equipment AS e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM demo.failure_events AS f
    WHERE f.equipment_id = e.equipment_id
      AND f.occurred_at >= DATEADD(MONTH, -6, CAST('2026-10-01' AS datetime2(0)))
      AND f.occurred_at < CAST('2026-10-01' AS datetime2(0))
);
approved_sql: SELECT TOP 1001 [e].[equipment_id] AS [equipment_id], [e].[site_id] AS [site_id], [e].[asset_code] AS [asset_code], [e].[equipment_type] AS [equipment_type], [e].[commissioned_at] AS [commissioned_at], [e].[status] AS [status] FROM [demo].[equipment] AS [e] WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 AS [1] FROM [demo].[failure_events] AS [f] WHERE [f].[equipment_id] = [e].[equipment_id] AND [f].[occurred_at] >= DATEADD(MONTH, -6, CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATETIME2(0))) AND [f].[occurred_at] < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATETIME2(0)))
